items.name: EmitTo
items.summary: Describes how many rows should be emitted during grouping.

methods.name: take_needed
methods.summary: Removes the number of rows from `v` required to emit the right number of rows, returning a `Vec` with elements taken, and the remaining values in `v`.

items.name: GroupsAccumulator
items.summary: `GroupsAccumulator` implements a single aggregate (e.g. AVG) and stores the state for *all* groups internally.

methods.name: convert_to_state
methods.signature: fn convert_to_state(&self, values: &[ArrayRef], opt_filter: Option<&BooleanArray>) -> Result<Vec<ArrayRef>>
methods.summary: Converts an input batch directly to the intermediate aggregate state.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.signature: fn evaluate(&mut self, emit_to: EmitTo) -> Result<ArrayRef>
methods.summary: Returns the final aggregate value for each group as a single `RecordBatch`, resetting the internal state.

methods.name: merge_batch
methods.signature: fn merge_batch(&mut self, values: &[ArrayRef], group_indices: &[usize], total_num_groups: usize) -> Result<()>
methods.summary: Merges intermediate state (the output from [`Self::state`]) into this accumulator's current state.

methods.name: size
methods.summary: Amount of memory used to store the state of this accumulator, in bytes.

methods.name: state
methods.signature: fn state(&mut self, emit_to: EmitTo) -> Result<Vec<ArrayRef>>
methods.summary: Returns the intermediate aggregate state for this accumulator, used for multi-phase grouping, resetting its internal state.

methods.name: update_batch
methods.signature: fn update_batch(&mut self, values: &[ArrayRef], group_indices: &[usize], opt_filter: Option<&BooleanArray>, total_num_groups: usize) -> Result<()>
methods.summary: Updates the accumulator's state from its arguments, encoded as a vector of [`ArrayRef`]s.
